nodes.description: Privileged owner address of SONGOKU, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used in access-control checks
Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances, written by approve and transferFrom
Owner-controlled whitelist address accepted by ensure() and set via setTradeAddress
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition()
Whitelist mapping marking addresses that bypass sale limits; written by _mints and read by ensure()
Minimum allowed transfer amount enforced by condition(), configured in init()
Maximum allowed transfer amount enforced by condition(), configured in init()
Maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition(), configured in init()
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor from the _supply argument
Token decimals constant (18) used for supply and sale-limit scaling
Constant Uniswap router address 0x7a25...488D treated as a whitelisted sender in ensure()
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
Public payable core transfer routine: allowance deduction, ensure() gate, unchecked balance mutation, _onSaleNum increment, Transfer event
Public payable function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval
Internal view whitelist gate: allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition()
Internal view sale-limit check over _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker/owner supplied address and calldata
Privileged mint function setting balanceOf[spender] and marking spender as canSale
Owner-only function configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and loops over recipients
Owner-only setter that assigns tradeAddress
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address from factory and token pair via keccak256
Payable constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and caller identity checks throughout the contract
Low-level delegatecall executed inside delegate() with owner-supplied target and calldata, allowing full storage takeover
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (no SafeMath), can overflow and under-account balances
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath
_value parameter of transferFrom used for allowance and balance arithmetic
_from parameter of transferFrom, source address checked by ensure() and allowance logic
_to parameter of transferFrom, destination address receiving tokens
_tos array parameter of batchSend, its length feeds the unchecked multiplication
_value parameter of batchSend used for per-recipient amounts and total computation
a parameter of delegate, the target contract of the delegatecall
b bytes parameter of delegate, the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall
spender parameter of _mints, address that receives minted balance and canSale flag
addedValue parameter of _mints, token amount scaled by decimals
Local variable total in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
msg.sender is passed as the source address into transferFrom by transfer
msg.sender determines allowance spender identity and callers can be any external address
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before executing delegatecall
_mints requires msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded privileged address
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transferring balances
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting the whitelist address
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants initial supply
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for the source and destination
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
transferFrom performs unchecked subtractions/additions on balanceOf without SafeMath
ensure requires condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted
ensure compares _from and _to against the privileged owner address
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address
ensure compares _from against the mutable tradeAddress whitelist
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass sale restrictions
ensure computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor to whitelist the pool address
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales per address
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer value
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer value
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
delegate performs an external delegatecall to an owner-supplied target with owner-supplied calldata
parameter a is the delegatecall target address used inside delegate
parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] when addedValue > 0
_mints silently sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting an address
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals
init writes _minSale derived from the token argument
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken argument
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument
init uses decimals to scale the sale limits
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and every recipient
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
batchSend gates execution on msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable
pairFor is invoked from ensure to derive the whitelisted pool address
constructor assigns the owner state variable from msg.sender
constructor writes totalSupply from the _supply argument
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and event emitter
_value parameter drives allowance check and balance mutation inside transferFrom
_from parameter is the debited address in transferFrom
_to parameter is the credited address in transferFrom
_tos param is iterated in batchSend and its length feeds the total computation
_value param of batchSend is multiplied by the recipient count and credited per recipient
spender param of _mints is credited and whitelisted in canSale
addedValue param of _mints sets the minted balance when greater than zero
local total is computed from the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
